verdict.sentence: Some algae possible, 54°F water, calm Tuesday morning.

level.note: No gauge on this lake. A level trend from the shoreline starts after the next clear days.

clarity.label: Some algae possible
clarity.note: Last clear view: about a week ago. 1 cloudy pass since.

ice.caveat: Ice thickness is an estimate from air temperature, not a measurement. Check the ice yourself before going on it.

days.summary: Best bite 6:00 am to 8:15 am (sunrise). Also good 9:15 am to 11:30 am.
Best bite 3:30 pm to 5:30 pm (sunset and moonset). Also good 6:00 am to 6:45 am.

fishing.note: Based on sun and moon times and the wind forecast. A guide, not a promise.
